Claude Fable 5.2 + TradingView... just took full control of the chart & it's f*cking DANGEROUS...

this FREE indicator scores every closed candle for AI agents, & this MCP bridge plugs Claude Code straight into TradingView, so Fable 5.2 reads the signal panel LIVE & calls SHORT, LONG or WAIT on its own

i rebuilt the setup as a paper desk & replayed every 4h candle of BTC, ETH & SOL from Nov 1 to Nov 17: Fable took 7 trades, said WAIT 6 times & all 6 closed trades ended green (+9.01R)

first understand how this setup works:

> you see candles, an AI agent can't read a chart
> the indicator scores every closed candle out of 100 for long & short & puts the signal, entry, stop & targets in a panel on your chart
> the bridge connects Claude Code to TradingView Desktop on your machine, so Fable 5.2 reads that panel, switches symbols & replays history by itself

how to use it with Fable 5.2:

1. paste ai-agent-lens.pine from the indicator repo into the Pine Editor on TradingView & hit "add to chart"

2. every closed candle gets a long & a short score out of 100, built from 5 factors, with no repainting

3. each setup comes with an entry, an ATR stop & 1.5R / 3R targets, drawn on your chart like TradingView's position tool

4. paste the install prompt from tradingview-mcp's README into Claude Code: it clones the repo, runs npm install & adds the MCP server for you

5. launch TradingView Desktop in debug mode with ONE command, the repo has the script for Mac, Windows & Linux

6. ask Claude to run tv_health_check & once it says connected, Fable 5.2 sees your chart

7. give Fable 5.2 agent/AGENT_PROMPT.md from the indicator repo & ask for the signal: decision, entry, stop, targets, size & exactly why it could fail

8. run tv stream tables & the indicator's panel streams into your terminal as JSON every time it changes

9. put it on ANY date with tv replay start & let Fable trade the chart bar by bar
